featured_reviews.name: Mamta Solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
Circle Wealth Advisors Pvt Ltd develop an overall strategy for our client to meet their needs and goals through an array of Wealth Management service, that includes 3 steps which are Planning, Execution and Monitoring.
At Planning stage, we establish details about your assets and liability, income and expenditure, your relationship with the money, goals and aspirations for the short as well as long term, and also your commitment to meet your objective. After getting the understanding of the data gathered, we create a goal based plan, in which we align your all current investment with your goals and assess if there are any gaps in the current situation. Later, we present our recommendations in the written format which is our action plan.
At Execution stage, we implement the mutually agreed action plan. We will execute the plan only after your consent and not before that.
At Monitoring stage, which is also the most crucial part of the process of wealth management because it is the long term plan and it requires regular quarter as well as annual reviews. Any changes in circumstances, goals, preferences can be inculcated in the plan will during the review. We keep checking returns generated, corpus required for our goal is same, whether the planned goals are relevant or not and any new goals or aspiration being added.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Mamta for detailing out the intricate process we follow to meet client expectations and set them on the path of financial independence.

I subscribed with Omkara Capital six months ago, and I’m very impressed with the quality and consistency of their service. What stands out is their research-backed recommendations — every stock idea is supported by clear data analysis, which gives me confidence in my investment decisions.
Varinder Bansal and the team are very approachable — they explain things patiently, offer regular guidance, and help you understand the nuances even when markets are tough.
Also, I feel genuinely that Omkara treats its clients like part of a family: trustworthy, transparent, and always aiming to help not just grow wealth, but understand the process.

Highly recommend Omkara Capital to anyone seeking serious equity research and sincere support.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for sharing such thoughtful feedback. At Omkara Capital, we believe that research-backed clarity, transparency, and personal guidance are the foundation of long-term investing. It is truly encouraging to know that our efforts have added value to your journey. Your trust inspires us to keep serving our investor community with the same commitment and integrity.

featured_reviews.name: Tulsiram Anil Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been a subscriber to Omkara Capital’s research services for the past couple of years. I would rate them among the best research advisory firms. Their investment style suits my temperament: they don’t chase momentum, they respect valuations, and they keep subscribers updated on Telegram with clear insights into their thinking process. They also share regular technical views on stocks, which I find helpful. They also have a website where they post detailed research reports.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for sharing your experience. We are delighted to know that our long-term, valuation-driven approach and regular updates on Telegram and our website have added value to your investment journey. At Omkara Capital, our focus is on research depth, transparency, and consistent communication to support investors with clarity and confidence.
